newsitem.title: USA: Continental Air sees strong Q1 bookings.
newsitem.headline: Continental Air sees strong Q1 bookings.

text.p: Continental Airlines Inc on Tuesday said it expected to have a good year, with advanced bookings starting strong in the first quarter.
"The first looks great; it looks a lot like the fourth quarter did. Our bookings look good going into the first quarter, so we plan to have a good 1997," Continental President Greg Brenneman said.
The company declined to provide specific forecasts.

Earlier, Continental said fourth-quarter earnings rose to $47 million, or $0.61 a share fully diluted, from $41 million, or $0.55, in the year-earlier period. Operating revenues climbed to $1.56 billion from $1.423 billion.
